content: 1. The Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition (GAIN) in Geneva, Switzerland, focuses on micronutrients, nutrition programs, and epidemiology. 2. Professor Orish Ebere Orisakwe, from the Toxicology Unit at the Faculty of Pharmacy, University of Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria, specializes in pharmacology, food safety, and toxicology. 3. The WHO guideline recommends the use of multiple micronutrient powders for point-of-use fortification of foods consumed by infants and young children aged 6–23 months and children aged 2–12 years. 4. Dr. Mical Paul, from the Infectious Diseases Unit at Rabin Medical Center, Belinson Hospital, and the Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel, is an expert in infectious diseases and HIV. 5. Professor Dalip Ragoobirsingh, from the University of the West Indies, Faculty of Medical Sciences, Mona, Kingston, Jamaica, leads the Diabetes Education Programme and specializes in medical biochemistry and diabetology. 6. Professor H.P.S. Sachdev, from the Sitaram Bhartia Institute of Science and Research in New Delhi, India, is an expert in pediatrics and systematic reviews. 7. Ms. Rusidah Selamat, from the Nutrition Division, Department of Public Health, Ministry of Health, Malaysia, based in Putrajaya, Malaysia, focuses on public health nutrition. 8. Dr. Rebecca Joyce Stoltzfus, from the Division of Nutritional Sciences at Cornell University, Ithaca, United States, specializes in international nutrition, public health, iron and vitamin A nutrition, and program research. 9. Dr. Igor Veljkovik, from UNICEF in Skopje, North Macedonia, is involved in program implementation. 10. Dr. Maged Younes, from the Committee on World Food Security (CFS) at the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in Rome, Italy, focuses on food safety, public health, and program management. 11. Dr. Maria de las Nieves García-Casal, a consultant at the Evidence and Programme Guidance Department of Nutrition for Health and Development at WHO headquarters, contributes to evidence-based program guidance. 12. Mr. Leendert Maarten Nederveen, a technical officer in the Surveillance and Population-based Prevention Department of Noncommunicable Diseases Prevention at WHO, works on population-level prevention strategies. 13. Dr. Juan Pablo Peña-Rosas, a coordinator in the Evidence and Programme Guidance Unit, Department of Nutrition for Health and Development at WHO, provides leadership in evidence-based nutrition programs. 14. Dr. Lisa Rogers, a technical officer in the Evidence and Programme Guidance Department of Nutrition for Health and Development at WHO, focuses on program guidance. 15. Mr. Gerardo Zamora, a technical officer in Implementation Research and Equity at the Evidence and Programme Guidance Department of Nutrition for Health and Development at WHO, specializes in implementation research. 16. Dr. Kunal Bagchi, a regional adviser on nutrition and food safety at the WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia in New Delhi, India, provides expertise in regional nutrition strategies. 17. Dr. Chessa Lutter, a regional adviser on child and adolescent health at the WHO Regional Office for the Americas/Pan American Health Organization in the United States, focuses on child health. 18. Dr. Ruben Grajeda Toledo, an adviser on nutrition and social determinants at the WHO Regional Office for the Americas, Pan American Health Organization, United States, works on nutrition and its social determinants. 19. Dr. Robert J. Berry, from the Prevention Research Branch at the National Center on Birth Defects and Developmental Disabilities, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, United States, specializes in prevention research. 20. Ms. Nita Dalmiya, from UNICEF in New York, United States, contributes to child nutrition initiatives. 21. Dr. Julia Finkelstein, from the Division of Nutritional Sciences at Cornell University, Ithaca, New York, United States, focuses on nutritional science research. 22. Dr. Elvira González de Mejía, from the Department of Food Science and Human Nutrition at the University of Illinois, United States, specializes in food science and human nutrition. 23. Dr. Jeff Gwirtz, from the Food Fortification Initiative in the United States, works on food fortification programs. 24. Dr. Chowdhury Jalal, from the Micronutrient Initiative in Canada, focuses on operations and evaluation research. 25. Mr. Phillip J. Makhumula-Nkhoma, an independent consultant based in Tuckahoe, New York, United States, provides expertise in nutrition consulting. 26. Dr. Luis A. Mejía, from the Department of Food Science and Human Nutrition at the University of Illinois, United States, specializes in food science and nutrition. 27. Dr. Helena Pachón, from the Food Fortification Initiative at Emory University, United States, works on food fortification strategies. 28. Mr. Peter Ranum, an independent consultant in the United States, contributes to nutrition and food fortification. 29. Mr. Georg Steiger, from DSM Nutritional Products in Switzerland, focuses on nutritional product development. 30. Dr. Parminder S. Suchdev, from Emory University, Division of Hospitalist Medicine, and Rollins School of Public Health, United States, specializes in public health and hospitalist medicine. 31. Dr. Mirak Raj Angdembe, from FHI 360 in Kathmandu, Nepal, contributes to public health initiatives. 32. Professor Marly Augusto Cardoso, from the Department of Nutrition at the School of Public Health, University of Sao Paulo, Brazil, specializes in public health nutrition. 33. Ms. Nuzhat Choudhury, from the Nutrition and Clinical Services Division at the International Centre for Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh (icddr,b), focuses on clinical nutrition. 34. Dr. Francisco Guillén-Grima, from the Department of Health Sciences at the Public University of Navarra, Spain, specializes in health sciences. 35. Dr. Ana-Lucia Mayen-Chacón, from Guatemala City, Guatemala, works on nutrition and social determinants of health. 36. Mr. Alejandro Vargas, from Action Against Hunger in Lima, Peru, contributes to hunger alleviation programs. 37. Dr. Pattanee Winichagoon, from the Institute of Nutrition at Mahidol University, Thailand, specializes in nutrition research. 38. Dr. Stanley Zlotkin, from the Centre for Global Child Health at The Hospital for Sick Children and the University of Toronto, Canada, is a professor in pediatrics, nutritional sciences, and public health. 39. Peer reviewers’ names and affiliations are acknowledged for their contributions to the guideline but do not imply endorsement of the recommendations or represent the views of their institutions.
